AreaItemList.description:
A cursor-paginated page of the priced rows behind a drawn area's price index.

Items are ordered by ``amount_minor`` (cheapest first), then by the row's
business key, so the order is total. ``as_of`` is the earliest refresh
instant on the page; null when ``items`` is empty. ``next_cursor`` is null
on the last page.
AreaItemList.title: AreaItemList

AreaItemResponse.description:
One priced item or variant row behind a drawn area's price index.

``item_id`` is the node's id for ``GET /v1/items/{item_id}/price-history``.
``item_name`` is the item's name; ``variant_name`` the variant's (e.g. a
size), null on an item's own price. ``age_seconds`` is the observation's age
at request time, never negative; null when there is no observation time.
AreaItemResponse.title: AreaItemResponse

ErrorResponse.description: The uniform error body returned by every non-2xx response.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

MenuItemResponse.description:
A dish. ``name`` is null when the source names no item. ``id`` is the
node's ``item_id`` for ``GET /v1/items/{item_id}/price-history``; null when
the item has no prices of its own (only its variants or modifiers are).
MenuItemResponse.title: MenuItemResponse

MenuOptionResponse.description:
A variant (e.g. a size) or a modifier (an add-on) and its prices.

``id`` is the node's ``item_id`` for ``GET /v1/items/{item_id}/price-history``.
MenuOptionResponse.title: MenuOptionResponse

MenuPriceResponse.description:
One price of a menu node in one effective context.

``amount_minor`` is null unless ``state`` is ``priced``. ``age_seconds`` is
the observation's age at request time (``observed_at`` to now, never
negative); null when there is no observation time.
MenuPriceResponse.title: MenuPriceResponse

MenuResponse.description:
One source menu (a source record's page stream) and the scope it was
claimed for. ``organization`` prices are the operator's shared claims,
never merged into this venue's own (ADR-0005 §11). ``source_url`` is the
page its most recent price was read from (ADR-0008 Amendment 4); null when
no price's provenance reaches a fetched page.
MenuResponse.title: MenuResponse

MenuSectionResponse.description:
A named section of a menu. ``name`` is null when the source names no
section. ``id`` is the section's ``item_id`` for its price history; null
unless the section is priced.
MenuSectionResponse.title: MenuSectionResponse

PriceHistoryPointResponse.description:
The accepted answer from ``known_from`` until the next point.

``known_from`` is the acceptance instant of the page that made this the
answer. ``amount_minor`` is null unless ``state`` is ``priced``;
``observed_at``, ``source_kind`` and ``confidence`` are null for a derived
state (``absent``, ``withdrawn``, ``unresolved_base``).
PriceHistoryPointResponse.title: PriceHistoryPointResponse

PriceHistoryResponse.description:
The accepted observation trail behind one menu node's prices.

Computed live from committed Menu, so ``as_of`` is the request instant.
PriceHistoryResponse.title: PriceHistoryResponse

PriceIndexAreaResponse.description:
The price index of the placed venues inside a drawn boundary (ADR-0020 §3).

``boundary`` is the normalized corners as ``[lat, lon]`` pairs, without a
closing repeat. Each item is computed exactly as a stored price-index row
is, over the venues the index places inside the boundary: shared chain
menus and multi-venue organizations are left out, so ``venue_count`` can
be lower than the number of venues with a menu there. ``as_of`` is the
refresh instant of those placements; null, with ``items: []``, when the
boundary holds no placed venue.
PriceIndexAreaResponse.title: PriceIndexAreaResponse

PriceIndexCellList.description:
A cursor-paginated page of every price-index row of one area kind.

Items are ordered by ``(area_key, category_kind, category_key,
currency_code)``: text order, not map order. Every cell of the kind spans
``cell_size_degrees`` north and east of its corner; null for ``all``.
``as_of`` is the earliest refresh instant on the page; null when ``items``
is empty. ``next_cursor`` is null on the last page.
PriceIndexCellList.title: PriceIndexCellList

PriceIndexCellResponse.description:
One price-index row of the listed area kind: its area and its group.

``area_key`` is the value ``GET /v1/venues`` takes as ``area`` with the same
``area_kind``. ``cell_lat``/``cell_lon`` are the cell's south-west corner;
null for the citywide ``all`` row.
PriceIndexCellResponse.title: PriceIndexCellResponse

PriceIndexGroupResponse.description:
Venue-weighted price statistics for one category and currency of a cell.

Each venue weighs one: its sample is the median of its priced rows, and the
statistics are over those venue medians, in integer currency minor units.
``low_sample`` is true when ``venue_count`` is below ``min_venues``; the
statistics are null when ``venue_count`` is 0. ``organization_venue_count``
venues were placed through their Organization's own menu. ``priced_count``
and ``unpriced_count`` count the item/variant rows behind the group.
``age_seconds`` is the oldest observation's age at request time, never
negative; null when nothing is priced.
PriceIndexGroupResponse.title: PriceIndexGroupResponse

PriceIndexResponse.description:
The price index for the lat/lon grid cell containing the requested point.

The cell is named by its south-west corner (``cell_lat``, ``cell_lon``) and
spans ``cell_size_degrees`` north and east. ``as_of`` is the index's
refresh instant; null, with ``items: []``, when the index has no row for
the cell.
PriceIndexResponse.title: PriceIndexResponse

PriceTrailResponse.description: The points of one effective context and currency, oldest first.
PriceTrailResponse.title: PriceTrailResponse

VenueList.description: A cursor-paginated page of venues; ``next_cursor`` is null on the last.
VenueList.title: VenueList

VenueMenuResponse.description:
A venue's current menu from Gold. ``as_of`` is the oldest refresh
instant behind the served rows; null when there is no current menu.
VenueMenuResponse.title: VenueMenuResponse

VenueResponse.description:
A venue: one Organization operating at one Place (an Establishment).

``organization_id`` is the operating Organization's id, the value the
list's ``organization`` filter takes.
VenueResponse.title: VenueResponse

get.description: Liveness probe. The process is up; does not touch the database.
Readiness probe. Confirms the database is reachable.

Return one trail per effective context and currency, oldest point first.

``item_id`` is the ``id`` of a node in ``GET /v1/venues/{id}/menu``. A point
is emitted each time a newly accepted page changed the node's accepted local
answer: its state, amount and the page it came from. A trail usually ends
``absent`` once a newer capture of the menu is accepted: each capture's
nodes are their own targets, so the trail shows when a price was accepted,
corrected, withdrawn or superseded, not the dish's price across captures.
Computed live from committed Menu, so ``as_of`` is the request instant and
the item keeps its history after it leaves the current menu.

404.description: The item_id names no target its scope ever priced.

get.description:
Return the venue-weighted price statistics of the cell containing ``lat``/``lon``.

The cell is the ``area_kind`` grid's (0.01° by default). One item per
category and currency the index holds for the cell, narrowed by
``category_kind`` and ``currency`` when given. Groups below ``min_venues``
venues are served with ``low_sample: true``. A cell the index has no row for
is ``200`` with ``items: []`` and ``as_of: null``.

get.summary: Get the price index for the grid cell containing a point

get.description:
Return the venue-weighted price statistics of the placed venues inside ``boundary``.

Computed as every price-index row is (ADR-0020 §3): each venue's median,
then percentiles over those medians; groups below ``min_venues`` venues are
served with ``low_sample: true``. Only the venues the index places count,
so shared chain menus are left out. One item per category and currency,
narrowed by ``category_kind`` and ``currency`` when given. A boundary with
no placed venue is ``200`` with ``items: []`` and ``as_of: null``.

parameters.description: A drawn area: 3-50 corners as lat,lon pairs separated by ';' (WGS 84 degrees, plain decimals with at most 6 decimals), in any order or orientation; a final corner equal to the first is dropped. At most 1,200 characters and a bounding box of at most 2° of latitude and of longitude. A point is inside by even-odd ray casting, so a boundary that crosses itself is accepted; on an axis-aligned rectangle the south and west edges are inside and the north and east edges are not.
parameters.name: boundary

Return one page of the priced item and variant rows behind ``/v1/price-index/area``.

The rows of the venues the index places inside ``boundary`` (shared chain
menus left out, as from the median), cheapest first (ADR-0020 §4). Without
``q``, walking every page gives ``priced_count`` rows. The cursor names the
last row's price and business key, not a row id, so it survives a refresh;
it does not carry ``boundary`` or the filters: send the same ones with
every page. A boundary or ``q`` that matches nothing is ``200`` with
``items: []``.

Return one page of the ``area_kind`` rows, ordered by area key, category, currency.

The order is text order, not map order. The cursor does not carry the
filters: send the same ones with every page. It names the last row's key, not
a row id, so it survives a refresh; each page's ``as_of`` says which
snapshot it came from. A filter that matches nothing is ``200`` with
``items: []``.

get.summary: List every price-index row of one area kind (cursor-paginated)

get.description:
Return one page of current venues ordered by id, with an opaque cursor.

Filters are ANDed. The cursor does not carry them: send the same filters
with every page. A filter that matches nothing is ``200`` with ``items: []``.
The ``area`` and ``boundary`` lists are geographic: every current venue
whose point is in the area, not only the price index's contributors. One
geographic filter at a time: ``boundary`` with ``area`` or ``area_kind`` is
``422``.

get.description: Return a single current venue, or 404 if no such current Establishment.

404.description: No current venue has this id.

get.description:
Return the venue's current menu from Gold, or 404 if no such current venue.

The venue's own (Establishment) menus come first. Its Organization's menus
follow, labelled ``organization``, only when this venue is the
Organization's one current venue: a chain's shared menu is never fanned out
to its locations (ADR-0005 §11). Every price carries ``observed_at``, its
age at request time and its source kind; ``as_of`` is the oldest Gold
refresh instant behind the served rows. Each menu's ``source_url`` is the
page its most recent price was read from, resolved at request time in one
provenance read for the whole request (ADR-0008 Amendment 4). A current
venue with no menu in Gold is ``200`` with ``menus: []``.

404.description: No current venue has this id.
